name: pixel-twin-lab
description: In-place UI editing guard and temporary visual verification for existing frontend projects.

scripts.smoke: python3 scripts/pixel_twin.py inspect --project . && python3 scripts/pixel_twin.py --help && node scripts/browser_capture.cjs --help
scripts.check: python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests && node --check scripts/browser_capture.cjs && npm test
